bibl.title: The New Sappho Papyrus of Cologne or the Eternal Youth of Poetry.
bibl.seg: José-Antonio Fernández-Delgado, The New Sappho Papyrus of Cologne or the Eternal Youth of Poetry.
bibl.note: P. Colon. Inv. 21351 (= M.-P.3 1449.01; LDAB 10253). - In contrast to the idea of the first editors, who consider that Sappho's poem on old age is incomplete and that it continued in the four lines that follow the copy in P. Oxy. XV, 1787 (= MP3 1449; LDAB 3899), shows that the poem may be a complete, harmonious composition with unitary meaning.
